nearMissData.Observation Title: Unsecured High Pressure Steam Hose Near Walkway
nearMissData.Description of Unsafe Condition: Steam hose coupling safety pin was missing on line B-4 during line purge. Disconnect could have resulted in high temperature steam exposure to operators.
nearMissData.Immediate Action Taken: Line depressurized immediately and whip-check safety cable installed.

rcaData.Root Cause Analysis: Vibration loosened standard linchpin; safety whip-check cable was not affixed prior to pressurization.
rcaData.Contributing Factors: Lack of visual pre-start verification indicator on steam purge manifolds.

capaData.CAPA Title: Standardize Positive-Lock Safety Pins & Permanent Whip-Checks on Steam Headers
capaData.Corrective Action: Replace all slip pins with captive locking pins on utility purge stations across all plants.

closureData.Closure Review Notes: Positive-locking pins installed on all 18 steam purge points. Standard operating procedure updated and training verified.
closureData.Effectiveness Verification: No further loose connections detected in weekly audit.
